LanguageData.DMS_ArchiveCasket_UnsealedText: {PAWN} breaks the seam on {CASKET}. The file inside is one whole sealed technology, the file for {PROJECT} that the fleets have been keeping in pieces.\n\nThe technology is ours now. The next time anyone signs for that file, the fleets will find the shelf empty.
LanguageData.DMS_ArchiveCasket_PendingText: {PAWN} breaks the seam on {CASKET}. The file inside is whole, but it sits on foundations we do not have yet: {PREREQS}. The researchers take down what they can and shelve the rest; once the groundwork catches up, the file will be read out in full.
LanguageData.DMS_ArchiveCasket_DecodedText: With the groundwork finally in place, the file taken out of the casket can be read end to end. {PROJECT} is ours.
LanguageData.DMS_ArchiveCasket_AlreadyOpenText: The file in {CASKET} was opened long ago; only the seal is left. {PAWN} still works a little out of the residual encoding.
LanguageData.DMS_ArchiveCasket_EmptyText: {CASKET} never held a whole file: the fragments it was sealed from no longer resolve into one. {PAWN} still works a little out of the residual encoding.
